scope: Sequential host-process handler diagnostic on an empty isolated migrated database with no integrations/users, no external providers, ordinary default settings and Automation off. Includes query driver durations; not native image capacity. First five iterations cold/warmup.
limitations: No configured external providers or users; Automation off.
Prisma query event durations are integer milliseconds, not precise PostgreSQL execution timings.
Host CPU includes client and in-process Prisma work; not native container CPU or capacity.
Claiming, incident creation and unrelated jobs excluded from individual handler timings.
